title: Python (DEC-303): measure pyright call-hierarchy recall and precision, write the adapter ADR (adds a runtime dependency: dispatch-floor)
description: opum-doc DEC-303: glyph 0.1.0 adds Python through pyright-langserver --stdio behind a language-neutral LSP client adapter. DECIDE BEFORE BUILD: measure call-hierarchy, references and symbol recall and precision on ONE pinned real Python repository plus fixtures against a ground truth defined before pyright runs; record the pyright version; write the component ADR naming DEC-303 with the adapter design (spawn, framing, timeouts and wall-time budget, crash handling, exit 7 cases, language detection and override flag, command to LSP request mapping, stated limits); send both to opum-doc. No build code. Build slices start only after opum-doc accepts the measurement. Dispatch-floor: the eventual change adds a runtime dependency (pyright, npm), so each build slice carries an Opus review; this task itself writes an ADR and a measurement record.
implementationNotes: 2026-11-23 Measurement and ADR written (ADR 0008, status Proposed, names DEC-303; test/python-lsp-measurement/ holds the recorded artifact). Pins: pyright 1.1.414, psf/requests 3c7baaa05ab4aa49cc819ce3a819d260de19c157, node 24.22.2, git 2.56.0, host Python 3.15.2. Ground truth committed before the first pyright request (scratch repo, 09:15:32 and 09:16:23 -06:00). Headline: incoming-call recall 58/65 (0.892, 95% Wilson 0.794-0.947) with precision 58/58; with pythonPlatform All 59/65, the six misses all constructor calls to __init__ (call hierarchy attributes them to the class); 59/59 on the other kinds; 9/9 negative targets clean; documentSymbol 298/320 (the misses are @overload stubs and win32-only defs); workspace/symbol only 43/320 when files are not open; definition-at-call-site resolved 312 in package, 648 typeshed/stdlib, 66 none of 1028. Fixtures (adversarial, not a rate): incoming 17/28, failing on aliased-import calls, constructors, a decorator application, and one non-call listed as a call; outgoingCalls finds the aliased calls (63/65 real, 21/26 fixtures). All-open runs byte-identical 6/6; open-on-demand runs not reproducible. Small sample: one 19-file annotated repository, 65 true sites; cannot separate 97% from 99.9%. Decisions for opum-doc in the ADR: D1 unresolved-site count (LSP cannot enumerate calls), D2 mixed-language repositories, D3 the recall threshold. No build code.
